items.name: Adventurer
items.text: Immediately advance the Dragon marker one space along the Rage Track. Also worth :points#3: at the end of the game.

items.name: Barbarian
items.text: Immediately gain :sword#2: to use this turn. Also worth :points#2: at the end of the game.

items.name: Cleric
items.text: Immediately heal 1 damage. Also worth :points#2: at the end of the game.

items.name: Discount Coupon
items.text: You may use this token one time while buying an item from the Market to pay :gold#5: less. It is not a Prisoner for any purpose (such as Riot, Brave Hero, or the Warrior).
items.keep: Keep until you use it, then return it to the box.

items.name: Golden Monkey Bot
items.text: This counts as a Monkey Idol for all purposes, though it is worth :points#3: at the end of the game (instead of :points#5:).

items.name: Haunted Prisoner
items.text: Immediately take a Ghost cube from the Bank and place it in the Clank! area. Also worth :points#3: at the end of the game.

items.name: Mayor
items.points: 5 if you have a mastery token
items.text: Worth :points#5: at the end of the game, if you have a mastery token.

items.name: Monk
items.text: Worth :points#1: at the end of the game for each Wayshrine you have marked.

items.name: Peasant
items.text: Worth :points#2: at the end of the game.

items.name: Primatologist
items.points: 5 if you have a Monkey Idol
items.text: Worth :points#5: at the end of the game, if you have at least one Monkey Idol (which can be the Golden Monkey Bot).

items.name: Prince
items.text: Worth :points#5: at the end of the game, if you have a Crown.

items.name: Princess
items.text: Worth :points#5: at the end of the game, if you have a Crown.

items.name: Sorceress
items.points: 5 if you have two Secret Tomes
items.text: Worth :points#5: at the end of the game, if you have at least two Secret Tomes.

items.name: Warrior
items.text: Worth :points#1: at the end of the game for each Prisoner you have freed (including the Warrior himself).

items.name: Catacombs Map
items.text: Keep this token. For the rest of the game, you may move through one-way tunnels in the opposite direction of the arrow. Also worth :points#5: at the end of the game.

items.name: Chalice
items.text: Keep this token. It is worth :points#7: at the end of the game. It is not an Artifact.

items.name: Greater Skill Boost
items.text: Immediately gain :skill#5:, then return the token to the box.

items.name: Greater Treasure
items.text: This token counts as :gold#5:. You may keep it until the end of the game or spend it normally.

items.name: Potion of Greater Healing
items.text: Use during your turn to heal 2 damage.
items.keep: Keep until you use it, then return it to the box.

items.name: Dragon Egg
items.text: Keep this token. It is worth :points#3: at the end of the game. Advance the Dragon marker one space along the Rage Track.

items.name: Lockpick (secret)
items.text: Immediately return this secret to the box and take a Lockpick from the Bank.

items.name: Magic Spring
items.text: At the end of this turn, trash a card from your discard pile or play area. Return the card and this token to the box.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.text: Use during your turn to heal 1 damage.
items.keep: Keep until you use it, then return it to the box.

items.name: Potion of Swiftness
items.text: Use during your turn to gain :boot:.
items.keep: Keep until you use it, then return it to the box.

items.name: Potion of Strength
items.text: Use during your turn to gain :sword#2:.
items.keep: Keep until you use it, then return it to the box.

items.name: Puzzle Box
items.text: Keep this token until you enter a Wayshrine. There, return the token to the box and take a major secret from the Bank.

items.name: Treasure
items.text: This token counts as :gold#2:. You may keep it until the end of the game or spend it normally.

items.name: Backpack
items.text: Allows you to carry an additional Artifact. Also worth :points#5: at the end of the game. Costs :gold#7: in a Market room (2 in the box).

items.name: Blood Amulet
items.text: You must have at least 5 damage to buy this item. When you buy it, immediately heal 2 damage. Also worth :points#7: at the end of the game. Costs :gold#7: (2 in the box).

items.name: Burglar's Kit
items.text: When you buy this, immediately take two Lockpicks from the Bank. Also worth :points#2: at the end of the game. Costs :gold#7: (3 in the box).

items.name: Crown
items.text: Worth the number of points shown. Each player takes the most valuable Crown available when they buy one: :points#10:, then :points#9:, then :points#8:. Costs :gold#7: (3 in the box). A Crown also powers Prince, Princess, Corrupt Advisor, Floating Skull and Expensive Taste.

items.name: Artifacts
items.text: Seven tokens, stacked face up by value with the 5 on top and the 20 at the bottom. When you discover an Artifact room, take the top one (a "+" room takes the second, "++" the third) and place it in that room. Pick it up with the Take an Artifact action; you can carry only one (two with a Backpack). Taking one moves the Dragon marker up the Rage Track. You cannot escape or score without one; tie-break is the higher Artifact.

items.name: Monkey Idol
items.text: When you enter the Monkey Shrine room (on the starting tile), immediately take one Monkey Idol and put it in your personal supply. Worth :points#5: at the end of the game. A Monkey Idol is not an Artifact. Three in the box.

items.name: Mastery token
items.text: Take one when you escape: arrive at the Crypt with an Artifact, finish your turn, remove your pawn. Worth :points#20:. One per player is stacked near the Crypt at setup.

items.name: Ghost cube
items.text: White cube. Added to the Clank! area when a haunted tile is discovered (or by the Haunted Prisoner). In a Dragon Attack a drawn Ghost cube damages every player, then goes back to the Clank! area for the next attack.

items.name: Lockpick
items.text: Spend one to move through a Lock tunnel icon (place it on the icon; the tunnel stays unlocked for everyone) or to pick a Chest, Library or Prison. Each player starts with three. Not limited: substitute anything if they run out.

items.name: Gold
items.text: Coins of 1, 5 and 10. Worth :points#1: each at the end of the game. Spend :gold#7: for a Market item. Not limited.
